summary: Completed testing of new quote flow with redesigned sections: 1) Parámetros iniciales (Tipo, Cliente, Cantidad Cajas), 2) Selección de Medios de Pago (Banco -> Medio de Pago filtrado), 3) Matriz de resumen. All 70 backend API tests pass. Frontend code review confirms proper implementation of hierarchical bank->product selection and conditional UI visibility.

elements: data-testid='select-quote-type' - Quote type selector (VPOS, GATEWAY, MPOS, LINK)
data-testid='select-bank' - Bank selector with handleBankSelect function
data-testid='select-medio-pago' - Payment method selector (disabled until bank selected)
data-testid='add-medio-pago-btn' - Add button (disabled until both selectors filled)
section_2_payment_selection.filtering_logic: getCompatibilityField() maps VPOS->vpos_available, GATEWAY->gateway_available, etc. Products filtered from bank.products

finalize_button.visibility: Only shows when medios_pago_items.length > 0 (same as summary matrix)

banks_jsx.products_field: Banks have 'products' array with compatibility fields (vpos_available, gateway_available, mpos_available, link_available)
banks_jsx.add_product_ui: Dialog allows adding payment methods to bank with compatibility toggles

server_py.quote_endpoint: POST /api/quotes accepts client_id, quote_type, services[], hardware[], notes
server_py.bank_product_model: BankProduct has product_name, description, vpos_available, gateway_available, mpos_available, link_available
